quest.title: The Vanishing Bounty Target
quest.description: On the bounty board at The Flagship, there's a target known for vanishing without a trace after committing numerous heinous crimes. Yet justice demands retribution, and sins must be atoned for. Asking Leszek, an employee at The Flagship, may yield further information.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: There's a particularly tricky bounty at The Flagship with basically no leads.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The target was attacking people in the north of Lempo Isle, but now he's disappeared without a trace. No one seems to know where he's gone...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Every contact leaves a trace. No matter how carefully someone covers their tracks, in doing so, they always create new ones.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Besides, just because the bounty didn't include any extra information, doesn't mean whoever posted it doesn't have any.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I never thought of that... I'll go ask Leszek — with all my experience, I should be able to get something useful out of him.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I'll leave it to you then.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You can count on me, Boss Nef!

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Details on the targets are up on the board. I can fill you in if needed, but don't bother haggling over the bounties.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: About the bounty targets...

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: There are four targets on the board, but we only have leads for three. The first one's wanted for fraud...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Stop, stop, stop! Save me the spiel for the brand new treasure hunters — I could reel it off as well as you. You know who I'm here about.

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: The Curatorium wants to get involved?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That depends on how the Boss is feeling. Hmm, how did we arrive at you asking questions?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Anyway, seems to me the real reason Crackjaw's not been found is the lack of leads. Look at the board. You haven't even said what he looks like.

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Well, if these treasure hunters set off without even knowing who they're looking for, well, they're hardly a match for someone like Hark. I don't want some novices wasting their time, much less throwing away their lives.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Fair point. Apart from the scar on his chin, what else can you tell me about him? Preferably something no one else knows?

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Something no one else knows... You're looking for physical characteristics? Like, say, if he had some marks on his back?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That's exactly what I'm looking for! But how do you know so much about him?

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: I don't know squat. I never said he actually has any marks... Besides, even if he does, how are you going to see them?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: W—Well, yeah, sorta... *sigh* So, there's nothing you can tell me? We've always worked well together — can't you give me anything to work with?

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: After Hark revealed his true nature here in Nasha Town, he fled to the north of Lempo Isle and picked up his old life of crime.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That's old news. Everyone and their dog knows that.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: No one's reported seeing him recently. What if he went further north? I could maybe track him to Piramida, but what if he's made it all the way to Snezhnograd?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Nothing but ice and snow up there. I'm not sure if my arm would function in the cold...)

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: He hasn't. He's still on Lempo Isle — I just don't know where. You can consider that "something no one else knows."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh, how can you be so certain?

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Now that's a trade secret — you wanna know, you'll have to pay.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hah, stingy! Still, a hulk of a man with a scar on his face... Even on Lempo Isle, they're not hard to find. How'm I supposed to know which one's Hark?

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Well, seeing as how we "work together so well," I'll give you some free advice. Don't get too caught up in looking for a scar.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Are you saying, he's found some way to hide the scar on his chin?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I guess that makes sense. If everyone knows you as Crackjaw, walking around with no visible scar on your face would be a pretty good way to hide...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: In that case, I just need to find someone who's deliberately hiding their jawline, right? It's a lead, at least... Alright, if I find anything new, I'll come back and fill you in.

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: I'll wait with baited breath...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hmm... Seems like only yesterday, there were plenty of bounties going at The Flagship — now there's only one left.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: #Apparently, that's all down to {NICKNAME}. But even {M#he}{F#she} hasn't been able to crack this last one.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Well, there really aren't any leads—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ah, but... Just because something isn't written on the bounty board, doesn't mean it doesn't exist.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: What's this — a sudden flash of inspiration?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm going to ask Leszek — with all my experience, I should be able to get something useful out of him.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I'll leave it to you then.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You can count on me, Boss Nef!
